howItWorks.title: From equipment to decisions in three steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Mining telemetry made simple: from the equipment data bus to your dispatch control room screen.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: The ActiSky module is installed on the equipment and reads the CAN J1939 bus — RPM, fuel, temperature and GPS position, depending on the signals available on each machine. Oil pressure and temperature: integration under development, enabled after signal validation for each machine.

steps.title: Transmit
steps.text: Telemetry is sent to the Minefy platform in real time. In areas with an unstable signal, data can be stored on the module and retransmitted when connectivity returns, depending on the module and configuration deployed.

steps.title: Decide
steps.text: Dashboards, cycles and alerts reach the dispatch control room — giving your operation time to act, with decisions grounded in data.

items.a: ActiSky IoT modules are installed on equipment to read the CAN J1939 bus and transmit in real time — RPM, fuel, temperature and GPS, depending on the signals available on each machine — directly to the Minefy platform, where the data powers dashboards, cycles and alerts. Oil pressure and temperature: integration under development, enabled after signal validation for each machine.

items.q: How is it installed on my fleet?
items.a: Our technical team goes into the pit. Equipment installation is planned to avoid disrupting operations, with on-site module configuration and operator training. Support where mining happens, not just over the phone.

items.q: Does the platform integrate with my dispatch system?
items.a: Yes. Minefy telemetry already operates integrated with a mine management and dispatch system at a large-scale mining operation, providing the control room with data from large equipment.

items.q: Is my data secure and isolated?
items.a: The platform is multi-tenant, with data isolated by customer: each operation can see only its own data. Architecture and processes are aligned with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD), with role-based access control.

items.q: Does it work in areas with an unstable signal?
items.a: Yes. Depending on the module and configuration deployed, telemetry data is handled resiliently: in areas with intermittent connectivity, it can be stored on the module and retransmitted when the signal returns.
Industrial tablet rental + a platform subscription (SaaS), scaling by equipment and site. No large upfront investment: increase usage as your operation grows.

intro.text: Minefy Mining was founded on the conviction that Brazilian mining deserves world-class technology. Founded by professionals with direct experience in large-scale operations, we combine rugged hardware for harsh environments, real-time telemetry software and field expertise to deliver measurable results. Today, the same engineering that works at the mine site also serves the office: AI applied to business, autonomous agents and tailored IT services — our industrial heritage is the foundation, not the limit.

faq.title: Perguntas frequentes
faq.subtitle: O que produtores e gestores de frota agrícola perguntam antes de começar.

items.q: O que é a telemetria ActiSky aplicada ao agro?
items.a: São módulos IoT embarcados na máquina que leem o barramento CAN J1939 — RPM, consumo de combustível, temperatura do motor, pressão e GPS — direto para a plataforma Agrofy, onde viram dashboards, alertas e relatórios por talhão.

items.q: Como é a instalação na minha frota?
items.a: Nossa equipe técnica vai até a fazenda. A instalação é planejada para não atrapalhar a janela de safra, com configuração dos módulos e treinamento dos operadores no local — suporte onde a operação agrícola acontece, não só por telefone.

items.q: A Agrofy funciona com qualquer marca de máquina?
items.a: Sim. A leitura é direta do barramento CAN J1939 da máquina — não depende do portal de nenhum fabricante específico. Isso unifica tratores, colheitadeiras e pulverizadores de marcas diferentes num único painel. Suporte nativo ao barramento ISOBUS (agricultura de precisão) está no nosso roadmap.

items.q: Meus dados ficam seguros e isolados?
items.a: A plataforma é multi-tenant com isolamento por cliente: cada operação enxerga apenas os seus próprios dados. Arquitetura e processos alinhados à LGPD, com controle de acesso por perfil.

items.q: Funciona em áreas de sinal instável no campo?
items.a: Sim. A telemetria é tratada de forma resiliente: em áreas de conectividade intermitente — comuns em talhões afastados — os dados são armazenados no módulo e reenviados quando o sinal retorna.

Começamos com um piloto pago — uma frente ou unidade — com ROI medido dentro de um ciclo de safra. A partir daí, o modelo escala por equipamento e por site, com locação de tablets e assinatura da plataforma (SaaS).

intro.text: A Agrofy é a divisão de agronegócio do Grupo Minefy. Nascemos de uma constatação simples: a telemetria industrial que já protege e otimiza frotas de mineração — leitura de barramento CAN J1939, consumo, ociosidade, saúde do motor em tempo real — resolve exatamente os mesmos problemas em um trator, uma colheitadeira ou um pulverizador autopropelido. faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What operations, data and IT teams ask before getting started with Minefy.

items.a: We operate through two divisions. In mining, we bring together industrial tablets, ActiSky telemetry, fleet management, safety and rentals. In AI and IT, we integrate artificial intelligence with business systems, create tailored autonomous agents and develop applications, APIs and automations.

items.q: What is enterprise AI applied to my business?
items.a: It means connecting AI models to your real data and systems — ERP, spreadsheets, email and documents — to answer, classify, summarize and support decisions in your context, with scope and access defined by you. This is not a generic chatbot: it is AI with knowledge of your operation.

items.q: What can an autonomous agent do — and what does it not do?
items.a: An agent executes tasks from end to end within an authorized scope: it queries systems, prepares documents, triggers workflows and records everything. It does not have unrestricted access, does not fully replace a team, and requires human approval at the points you specify.

items.q: How does integration with my existing systems work?
items.a: We work with what is already there: APIs where available, and custom connectors built case by case where they are not — databases, spreadsheets, email and legacy systems. Integration design is part of the initial assessment, before any development begins.

Access scope defined by contract, credentials segregated by customer, auditable records of what each agent executes, and personal data processing in accordance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD). The limits on what AI can read and do are defined with you — and documented.
With an initial assessment: we understand the process, select an initiative with measurable outcomes and deliver a measured pilot. The pilot's own results determine whether to scale — not promises.

entrada.heading: A request arrives
entrada.text: An employee of Empresa Exemplo S.A. (fictitious) opens a ticket asking for guidance about the shift change.

conhecimento.heading: The agent searches the right sources
conhecimento.text: The question is compared with the company's knowledge base — policies, procedures and announcements — and the relevant sources are retrieved with references.

agente.text: The agent drafts the answer from the retrieved sources, cites every excerpt used and classifies the ticket by topic and urgency.

aprovacao.heading: A human approves before sending
aprovacao.text: Because the customer defined human approval for replies external to the team, the agent prepares everything and WAITS. Nothing goes out without the approver's sign-off.

resultado.heading: Answer sent and recorded
resultado.text: With the approval, the answer goes to the employee and the whole flow is recorded — who asked, what was consulted, who approved.

log: 09:14 · 2 sources retrieved from the knowledge base

entrada.heading: A batch of documents arrives
entrada.text: The finance team of Empresa Exemplo S.A. (fictitious) receives contracts and invoices in PDF that must become organized data.

conhecimento.heading: The agent understands each document
conhecimento.text: Each file is read and compared with the models the company uses — the agent knows what to look for in a contract and what to look for in an invoice.

agente.heading: Extraction and organization
agente.text: The agent extracts the fields, cross-checks them with the control spreadsheet and flags discrepancies — such as a term that does not match the amendment.

aprovacao.heading: The discrepancy waits for a human decision
aprovacao.text: The 11 consistent documents move forward; the discrepancy becomes a clear pending item for the manager to decide. The agent does not 'resolve' ambiguity on its own.

resultado.heading: Organized base, exception decided
resultado.text: With the decision recorded, the base is complete and auditable: every data point points back to the document and page it came from.

entrada.heading: An indicator leaves the range
entrada.text: On the operations panel (simulated), the queue time of a stage passes the agreed limit — the kind of signal that usually gets lost mid-shift.

conhecimento.heading: Context before opinion
conhecimento.text: The agent gathers the context: recent stage history, occurrences recorded in the shift and the operating procedure that covers this deviation.

agente.heading: Diagnosis and proposal
agente.text: Cross-checking the data, the agent builds a summary of the likely bottleneck and proposes the action foreseen in the procedure — with the numbers that justify it.

artifact.v: queue back in range in ~30 min (simulation)

aprovacao.text: Changing the operation's allocation is a human decision: the agent delivers the ready diagnosis and waits for the coordinator to approve, adjust or reject.

resultado.heading: Action recorded, cycle closed
resultado.text: Once the action is approved, the agent records the outcome and follows the indicator — if the queue does not return to range, the cycle reopens with the new context.
